tagline: 24cm of gel memory foam between a big dog and a hard floor.
lead: Hips and elbows stay cushioned however a big dog lands, because there is 24cm of foam underneath them.
value: Depth is the one thing that can't be faked, and the first thing a cheaper bed cuts. Oak keeps all 24cm of it.
intro: Oak is an orthopaedic dog bed made from contouring gel memory foam, 24cm deep, in Large and XL. The cover comes off to wash.
points: A lot of foam underneath them, so heavy dogs are cushioned however they lie.
Contours to their shape, with gel worked through the foam.
Large and XL, for dogs who need room to stretch.
Unzips and washes, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Large and giant breeds, heavy dogs, and older dogs who like a deep, cushioned bed.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Not sure between Large and XL? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it as the sewn-in label says, then let it dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: 24cm Gel Memory Foam Orthopaedic Dog Bed | Snoozly
seo_description: 24cm of gel memory foam that cushions big dogs' hips and elbows however they land. Orthopaedic bed for large and giant breeds. Large & XL, washable cover.
